glyph-orientation-vertical.description: Controls glyph rotation in vertical SVG text. This legacy property is deprecated; use text-orientation for new layouts.

scroll-axis-lock.description: Controls whether the browser can constrain a scrolling gesture to one axis. Use none when diagonal scrolling must remain available.

values.auto: Allows the browser to lock a gesture to one scrolling axis.
values.none: Keeps diagonal scrolling available by disabling axis locking.

window-drag.description: Marks a region that can move an application window when dragged. A move region consumes the drag gesture instead of delivering normal pointer and mouse events.

values.none: Leaves this element available for ordinary interaction.
values.move: Uses this element as an area for dragging the window.

view-transition-group.description: Controls nesting of named view-transition groups. Use containment to preserve ancestor effects such as clipping during a transition; this has no effect when view-transition-name is none.

values.normal: Nests inside the nearest ancestor group that establishes containment, or the transition root.
values.contain: Establishes a container for descendant transition groups.
values.nearest: Nests inside the nearest ancestor transition group, even without explicit containment.

speak.description: Controls whether an element participates in synthesized speech. This affects aural presentation rather than visual layout.

values.auto: Follows the element visibility when deciding whether to speak its text.
values.never: Excludes the element from synthesized speech.
values.always: Includes the element in synthesized speech regardless of its visual display.

stroke-color.description: Sets the solid paint color for strokes around text or SVG shapes. Use the stroke shorthand when changing the complete stroke, and this property when changing only its color.

text-decoration-skip-spaces.description: Controls whether underline, overline, and line-through decorations cross spaces, including decorations inherited from ancestors.

values.start: Omits decorations across spaces at the start of each line.
values.end: Omits decorations across spaces at the end of each line.

values.overlap-join: Extends intersecting segments to meet across the gap junction; uses zero inset at outer caps.
